proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer cannot tell whether high DRAM throughput comes from redundant reads (fixable by fusion/tiling) or from minimal necessary traffic at the bandwidth limit, nor whether insufficient grid parallelism prevents hiding memory latency.

rationale.dram__bytes_read.sum: HIGH -> fuse kernels or restructure to read each element once; LOW -> accept bandwidth limit and focus on reducing write traffic or vectorizing loads
rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: LOW -> increase grid size or reduce block size to launch more blocks; HIGH -> focus on reducing per-thread memory traffic rather than adding parallelism
